spans.s:
m. (-कुः)
1 A servant, a slave.
2 A blackguard.
3 A lecher, a libertine or debauchee.
n. (-कु)
Astronomy. astrology.
E.
श्लिष to embrace, Uṇādi aff. कु, and क substituted for the final.

r. 4th cl. (ञि ओऌ) श्लिषॢ (श्लिष्यति) r. 1st and 10th cls. (श्लेषति श्लेषयति)
1 To embrace.
2 To adhere or cling to.
3 To unite, to join or connect.
(उ) श्लिषु r. 1st cl. (श्लिपति)
To burn.

f. (-षा)
Embracing, an embrace.
E.
श्लिष to embrace, अङ् and टाप् affs.

Touched by, clung or adhered to.
E.
श्लिष to embrace, क्त aff.

mfn. (-ष्यन्-ष्यन्ती-ष्यत्)
Embracing, clinging, adhering to, being in close contact with.
E.
श्लिष to embrace, शवृ aff.

n. (-दं)
Morbid enlargement of the legs.

m. (-वः)
The mango tree.
E.
श्लीपद swelled^1 leg, and प्रभव production.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-हः)
A plant, (Nageia putranjiva.)
E.
श्लीपद, and अपह removing.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Prosperous, fortunate, affluent, happy.
E.
श्री good fortune, लच् poss. aff., and र changed to ल.
